capabilities: Number display equations that are linked
Show block links as equation numbers
extras: Read-only: numbers exist only on screen and in exported PDFs; notes are never modified. No network access or runtime dependencies. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0+. Limitations: only top-level $$ blocks are numbered, no per-line align numbering, and Canvas links are not counted. Beta channel available via BRAT.
intentEvidence: Equation Refs instead uses Obsidian's native block links, numbers only the equations you link to, and never edits your notes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to number display equations and reference them by number the way LaTeX's \eqref does.
